audit.framing_9x16: Centered vertical crop on the streamer's facecam with balanced upper and lower headroom, keeping facial expressions and reactions fully visible throughout the bit.
audit.subtitle_craft: Bold yellow rounded sans-serif font centered on screen, displaying chunked words one-by-one with highlight changes on key comedic words like 'VERY ANGRY'.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Subtle push-in on the streamer's face during her confused guessing phase, followed by a sudden wide hold for the realization beat.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Comedic thinking music (math equations overlay visual effect) during the puzzle phase, followed by the classic SpongeBob 'One Eternity Later' card transition, and a satisfying audio drop on the punchline realization.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: The setup outlines the riddle, holds on her genuine over-thinking awkward silence and wrong guesses, cuts to the meme transition, and lands right on her delayed comprehension facepalm.
standout_techniques: Floating math equations doodle overlay during deep thought moments
SpongeBob 'One Eternity Later' time-card transition for comedic pacing
Dynamic italicized action text (*reads chat*, *dies inside*) for emotional beat staging
Word-by-word bold caption chunking with highlight color shifts
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Leaving dead air unedited during long thinking pauses without visual or audio gags
